name: Can I fix a foggy window myself or do I need a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a foggy window myself or do I need a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While there are DIY kits claiming to remove condensation from between window panes, these often provide temporary or unsatisfactory results and can void manufacturer warranties. The underlying issue is a failed seal, which requires specialized tools and techniques to properly repair or, more commonly, replace the entire insulated glass unit. For a lasting solution that restores your window's thermal performance and appearance, it is highly recommended to consult a professional general contractor. They ensure the correct glass is ordered and installed properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fixing a foggy window yourself is difficult and often temporary; a professional is recommended for proper insulated glass unit replacement.
